topic: A school bag on Monday morning.

episode.title: If School Bags Could Talk: Monday Morning

shots.narration: It's Monday, and they're feeding me furniture again.
shots.scene: Cosy modern hallway, vertical 9:16 composition, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text or logos.
shots.action: A pair of hands lowers an oversized stack of plain schoolbooks into a blue school bag with big alarmed eyes and a tiny open mouth.
shots.mood: Bright morning light, exaggerated alarm, colourful domestic comedy.

shots.narration: Five minutes ago, I was enjoying my weekend crumbs.
shots.scene: Earlier that morning in a cosy hallway corner, vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text or logos.
shots.action: The blue school bag with big sleepy eyes and a tiny contented mouth reclines against a shoe rack with crumbs inside its open top.

shots.scene: Cosy hallway beside a shoe rack, vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text or logos.
shots.action: A hand yanks the blue school bag with big startled eyes and a tiny round mouth upright by its top handle.

shots.narration: Apparently, every book deserves a personal ride.
shots.scene: Hallway bench beneath coat hooks, vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, plain unmarked schoolbooks.
shots.action: A hand wedges one more thick book into the blue school bag with big strained eyes and a tiny clenched mouth.

shots.narration: And the bottle gets its own luxury apartment.
shots.scene: Hallway bench with an overfilled school bag, vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text or logos.
shots.action: A hand slides a tall plain water bottle into the side pocket of the blue school bag with big sideways-looking eyes and a tiny annoyed mouth.
shots.mood: Cheerful colours, petty jealousy, visual imbalance.

shots.narration: [surprised] Wait, that lunchbox spent the weekend in here?
shots.scene: Close view of the bag on the hallway bench, vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text or logos.
shots.action: A hand lifts a food-stained lunchbox from the blue school bag with big horrified eyes and a tiny downturned mouth.
shots.mood: Comic disgust, ominous discovery in sunny surroundings.

shots.narration: They removed lunch, then replaced it with gym shoes.
shots.scene: Cosy hallway bench near the front door, vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text or logos.
shots.action: A hand stuffs a pair of muddy gym shoes into the blue school bag with big pleading eyes and a tiny miserable mouth.

shots.narration: Now they're wondering why I'm difficult to close.
shots.scene: Overfilled school bag on a hallway bench, vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text or logos.
shots.action: A hand tugs the stuck zipper of the bulging blue school bag with big squeezed-shut eyes and a tiny tense mouth.
shots.mood: Physical comedy, stretched seams, mounting frustration.

shots.narration: [sarcastic] I'm the heavy one? Next, interrogate that lunchbox.
shots.scene: Sunny front doorway with the stained lunchbox left on the hallway bench, vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon style, no visible text or logos.
shots.action: The departing blue school bag with big accusing eyes and a tiny crooked mouth points one loose strap toward the abandoned lunchbox.
shots.mood: Triumphant blame-shifting, playful mystery, punchline finish.

episode.endHook: Next episode: the lunchbox explains its suspicious weekend leftovers.
episode.description: A school bag faces Monday morning with last week's crumbs and today's impossible workload. Getting packed is tough, but getting blamed is worse.
